evidence_fr.source: Technological developments in generative AI tools are increasingly being used to create competing offerings, such as AI powered digital planning and assistance, further increasing competition.

ai_positioning.summary: Expedia Group deploie l'IA generative sur ses verticales (Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo) via Romie (assistant voyage conversationnel base Trip Matching) et un partenariat strategique avec OpenAI. Refonte de la stack search/recommendation autour de modeles ML proprietaires. Pas un AI-first business mais use cases concrets cote consumer et plateforme B2B (EPS) deja en production.
evidence: Romie AI travel assistant lance 2024 sur app Expedia : itineraire generatif, group trip coordination, integration ChatGPT plugin
Partenariat OpenAI annonce 2023 : Expedia parmi premiers plugins ChatGPT, exploitation API GPT pour conversational booking
Trip Matching et price prediction ML : Expedia revendique 70 Pb de donnees voyage et 600+ data scientists
EPS (Expedia Partner Solutions) propose APIs B2B avec scoring/personnalisation ML aux partenaires (compagnies aeriennes, banques)
